name: Tickchak Embed
author: Tickchak

sections.description:
Tickchak Embed is a lightweight plugin that allows WordPress users to easily add Tickchak event forms into posts, pages, or widgets using a customizable shortcode.

You can control various parameters such as:
– ev (event code)
– title (button label)
– location (popup position: center, right, etc.)
– color (button color)

Example shortcode:
[tickchak_embed ev=”abc123″ title=”Buy Tickets” location=”center” color=”yellow”]

External services

This plugin connects to the external service Tickchak.co.il to embed event forms on your WordPress site.

The plugin loads a script from https://tickchak.co.il/form.loader.js to display the form widget.

No personal data is sent from WordPress to the service.

Tickchak service is provided by Tickchak Ltd.
– Terms of Use: https://tickchak.co.il/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://tickchak.co.il/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Use the shortcode as needed in any post or page
sections.faq:
Where do I get the ‘ev’ code?

You can copy it from your Tickchak event configuration page.
